content.content:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("/content/assets/9e2529a85d9a7bf0bd91.csv")
df.drop('state', axis=1, inplace=True)
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format="%d.%m.%y")
df['month'] = df['date'].dt.month
df.set_index('date', inplace=True)

df[df["month"]==6][["cases", "deaths"]].plot(kind="area", stacked=False)
plt.savefig('output/plot.png')

content.text: 面积图默认是叠加的，这就是为什么明确传递了**stacked=False**。

resolved.title: 散点图 Scatter Plot
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Scatter Plot[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A [b]scatter plot[/b] is used to show the relationship between two variables. 

For example, we can visualize how the cases/deaths are related:[code format="py" codeId="3248"]df[df["month"]==6][["cases", "deaths"]].plot(kind="scatter", x='cases', y='deaths')[/code]We need to specify the [b]x[/b] and [b]y[/b] columns to be used for the plot.[img id="4566" width="100%"]The plot contains 30 points since we used the data for each day in June.
[note]The data points look "scattered" around the graph, giving this type of data visualization its name.[/note]

content.content:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("/content/assets/9e2529a85d9a7bf0bd91.csv")
df.drop('state', axis=1, inplace=True)
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format="%d.%m.%y")
df['month'] = df['date'].dt.month
df.set_index('date', inplace=True)

df[df["month"]==6][["cases", "deaths"]].plot(kind="scatter", x='cases', y='deaths')
plt.savefig('output/plot.png')

content.text: 我们需要指定用于绘图的**x*和**y**列。
content.text_html:
We need to specify the x and y columns to be used for the plot.

content.text: 该图包含30个点，因为我们使用的是6月份每一天的数据。

content.text: 数据点看起来 "散落 "在图表周围，所以称为**散点图**。

The data points look "scattered" around the graph, giving this type of data visualization its name.

数据点看起来 "散落 "在图表周围，这种类型的数据可视化的名称由此而来。

resolved.title: 饼状图 Pie Chart
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Pie Chart[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

We can create a pie chart using [b]kind="pie"[/b].
Let's create one for cases by month:[code format="py" codeId="3249"]df.groupby('month')['cases'].sum().plot(kind="pie") [/code][img id="4567" width="100%"]Pie charts are generally used to show percentage or proportional data.
[note]Pie charts are usually used when you have up to [b]6[/b] categories.[/note]

content.text:
我们可以使用`kind="pie"`绘制一个饼状图。
让我们绘制一个按月计算的病例数饼状图：
content.text_html:
We can create a pie chart using kind="pie". Let's create one for cases by month:

我们可以使用**kind="pie "**创建一个饼图。 让我们创建一个按月计算的案例。

content.content:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("/content/assets/9e2529a85d9a7bf0bd91.csv")
df.drop('state', axis=1, inplace=True)
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format="%d.%m.%y")
df['month'] = (df['date'].dt.month_name()).str[:3]
df.set_index('date', inplace=True)

df.groupby('month')['cases'].sum().plot(kind="pie")
plt.savefig('output/plot.png')

content.text: 饼状图一般用于显示百分比或比例数据。
content.text_html:
Pie charts are generally used to show percentage or proportional data.

饼状图一般用于显示百分比或比例数据。

content.text: 饼状图通常在有**6**个以上类别时使用。
content.text_html:
Pie charts are usually used when you have up to 6 categories.

饼状图通常在你有多达6个类别时使用。
